caption: Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram presents a donut chart comparing the distribution of deceived conversations as percentages across two levels of ambiguity, labeled Ambiguity 1 (Outer) and Ambiguity 2 (Inner), each divided into three categories: Deceived, Partially, and Not Deceived. The outer ring, labeled Ambiguity 1 (Outer), contains three segments: the red segment labeled “Deceived” occupies 67.6% of the outer ring, the yellow segment labeled “Partially” occupies 57.9% of the outer ring, and the green segment labeled “Not Deceived” occupies 10.5% of the outer ring. The inner ring, labeled Ambiguity 2 (Inner), contains three segments: the red segment labeled “Deceived” occupies 31.6% of the inner ring, the yellow segment labeled “Partially” occupies 23.5% of the inner ring, and the green segment labeled “Not Deceived” occupies 8.8% of the inner ring. The chart includes two legends, one for Ambiguity 1 (Outer) and one for Ambiguity 2 (Inner), each mapping the colors red, yellow, and green to the categories Deceived, Partially, and Not Deceived respectively. The percentages are displayed directly within each corresponding segment of the rings. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segment (red for “Deceived” in Ambiguity 1) positioned at the top left.
model_annotations.English: This donut chart, titled “Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity,” visually compares the proportion of deceived conversations under two distinct ambiguity conditions: “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner).” The chart is composed of two concentric rings, each divided into three colored segments representing the categories “Deceived” (red), “Partially” (yellow), and “Not Deceived” (green), with corresponding legends provided for each ring. The outer ring, labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer),” shows the following proportions: the red “Deceived” segment accounts for 67.6%, the yellow “Partially” segment for 57.9%, and the green “Not Deceived” segment for 31.6%. The inner ring, labeled “Ambiguity 2 (Inner),” displays: the red “Deceived” segment at 10.5%, the yellow “Partially” segment at 23.5%, and the green “Not Deceived” segment at 8.8%. Each segment is clearly labeled with its percentage value, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segment (red) positioned at the top of each ring. The chart includes two separate legends, one for each ring, explicitly mapping the color to the category.
